system.description: If the total number of Breaches the Engines system has suffered is equal to the Scale of the ship, then the system has been Disabled. The Engines System cannot be used to perform or assist any Tasks (even those that would normally be Difficulty 0), loss of power generation means that the ship loses 2 Power at the end of every Round. The Difficulty to repair this is 5, though at the Gamemaster’s discretion this may be replaced with an Extended Task (Work 10, Magnitude 3, Resistance 2, base Difficulty 2).
